corrections.fieldOrRectangle: AcroForm text field "listed charges", the writable run inside the court's agency-sealing paragraph
corrections.observedResult: The participant's full legal name is printed inside the ORDER paragraph. The page reads: "The Kentucky State Police and other following agencies listed below are hereby ordered to seal any records in their custody regarding the above-named Defendant and above-listed charge(s):" followed on the next line by "Jordan Avery Reyes". The map binds {"field":"listed charges","class":"participant","factId":"participant.full_legal_name","factBasis":"printed_label","effectiveLabel":"their custody regarding the above-named Defendant and above-"} — the label match is against the court's own order sentence, so the participant name lands in the space where the agencies ordered to seal are listed.
corrections.requiredResult: The agency list inside the order is court and agency space and must be blank of participant-derived content. "listed charges" must not receive participant.full_legal_name; if it is to be written at all it holds charge text, and on an order the participant does not supply it.
corrections.smallestCorrection: Drop the "listed charges" binding from production-field-map.json, or exclude printed_label matches whose effectiveLabel falls inside a court-owned decision or agency paragraph, then re-render this family and refresh the sidecar. The Case No, Defendant and Defendants Birthdate bindings are correct and unaffected.
